newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks down by lunch on asset concerns.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks down by lunch on asset concerns.

text.p: Thai stocks eased by the lunch break on persistent worries about asset quality of Thai financial institutions which sparked further sales of bank and finance stocks, traders said.
The SET Index fell 9.87 points, or 1.80 percent, to 538.18. The SET 50 slipped 0.93 points, or 2.35 percent, to 38.62. Trade was 1.76 billion baht.
Brokers said upcoming release of rising non-performing loan data of financial institutions kept investors jittery.
"I think people are worried about the financial system ahead of the release of loan figures," said a local trader.
Declining confidence in the financial setor also raised fears of higher funding costs faced by banks and finance companies, analysts said.
Siam Commercial Bank, with its high lending growth last year, fell seven baht to 104. Thai Farmers Bank dropped two to 95.50.
Industrials were also hit by rising funding costs and lower earnings outlook, analysts said.
